failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Answers echoed a quoted clue or selected a salient related entity instead of resolving the full clue’s requested target and distinguishing details.

rejected_edits.content: When context gives a typical or primary answer alongside less-common possibilities, prefer the explicitly emphasized answer for a conventional fill-in clue; do not combine every compatible alternative into a list unless the question asks for an exhaustive set. Treat generic plural wording as insufficient by itself to require multiple answer items.
